top3: Credits/wallet money path is solid: SDK boots at file-include time as designed, sdk_money_ready()/is_enabled() both true, topup()/charge()/adjust() all move real money through the ledger and the portal Wallet balance/history reflect it exactly. All 12 D-row regression guards re-verified this pass: D1 (no double-count click), D2 (aggregation-safe totals), D3 (no false setup nag), D4 (single wp-header-end), D5 (Reports View link), D6 (Folders counts + status labels), D7 (backfill flag set), D8/D12 (portal CSV export is a real admin-post.php link, reachable by advertisers, rejects logged-out requests), D9 (tab-boolean contract fixed in code; live save blocked by sandbox), D10 (deleted-page option self-heals on load), D11 (orphaned report renders plain text, no esc_url(null) deprecation).

The one UI defect found this release (star-rating CSS missing from both plugins) was fixed during this QA cycle and re-verified clean across the classified single page and the admin Reviews table, at 1280/390px and light/dark - no open failures remain.
manual_required: Agent-harness notes (not product output, kept here only for a complete audit trail - none reflect real plugin/theme behavior): during the initial pass the agent's own wp-cli eval exploration produced three non-product debug.log lines that were removed from debug_log_issues per the calling session's correction: (1) a PHP warning from wp_update_plugins() failing to reach WordPress.org - this offline dev box has no outbound network access, unrelated to either plugin; (2) 'Unknown column business_name' - the agent queried a wrong/nonexistent column name against wp_wbam_advertisers while exploring the schema; (3) 'Unknown column advertiser_id' plus a fatal 'Call to private WBAM_Pro\Core\Pro_Plugin::__construct()' - the agent misused the SDK ledger table (real column is user_id) and incorrectly instantiated a singleton with `new` instead of its intended filter/accessor. All three are agent test-harness mistakes made while investigating, not product defects.

The re-verification walk for the star-rating fix (this pass) produced zero new debug.log lines end to end (baseline truncated to 0 bytes, stayed at 0 bytes through the full 1280/390 x light/dark x classified-single + admin-reviews walk).
